description: Reads, measures, checks, draws and changes floor plans kept in one plan file. An MCP tool server and command for AI agents.
rules: Write a plan rooms first: name the rooms with inside sizes and neighbours, and let grid_write_rooms work out the walls.
Read docs/agent-guide.md before writing a first plan.
Run grid_check after every change and retell its label, General guidance, not your local rules.
Never say a plan complies, is allowed or is approved; say what the checks found and what they did not check.
